# er605_policy_route (Resource)

Transmission > Routing > Policy routing. Rules are ordered by position; a rule may not overlap an existing one (router error 36002).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dst_ipgroup` (String) ip_group name
- `interfaces` (String) outgoing WAN, e.g. WAN1
- `mode` (String) Priority or Only
- `name` (String)
- `service_type` (String) service name, e.g. ALL
- `src_ipgroup` (String) ip_group name
- `timeobj` (String) time object, Any for always

### Optional

- `comment` (String)
- `position` (Number) 1-based order; defaults to last
- `state` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
